warnings: All bars print Ø → type RB (section 0.6/6). No concrete strength, steel grade or cover is printed anywhere in the set.
Bent-up bars ('ค.ม. L/5' = คอม้า) are merged into main_bar.bottom with a note, following house 129 (they lie at the bottom over mid-span).

The four column sections carry no printed column mark; they are drawn directly above ขยาย F1C1 (6-Ø15 = 3+3 on two leaders) and ขยาย F2C2 (4-Ø15 = 2+2), each in two heights 'ฐานราก → คานคอดิน' and 'คานคอดิน → หลังคา' — assigned C1 / C2 by that position; one entry per level (section 8).
B3' has no drawn section: its spec is the handwritten note under the beam sections (same as B3 but top 4-Ø15, bottom 2-Ø15); its stirrup is taken from B3 per 'เท่ากับของคาน B3'.

F1 / F2 here are the drawn design (hollow hexagonal piles 0.15 x 6.00). The handwritten alternative F1 / F2 for prestressed piles uses the same marks and is kept in its own file (_view5) to avoid an element_id collision.
The F1 mat diameter was blacked out and re-written by hand as 'Ø9' (F2 prints Ø9 directly) — Ø9 taken, flagged.
Timber (stage floor, joists, cover boards) is recorded only as notes on the stage detail / corbel entries.
